title: disposable bamboo chopsticks
text: disposable bamboo chopsticks. Easy to use and no splinters.  Come in paper sheaths.  I prefer washable reusable, but once in awhile you gotta go disposable.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

product_metadata.title: Bamboo Chopsticks Disposable, 100 Chop Sticks Packs, Wooden Chopsticks Bamboo, Japanese Chopsticks Wood Chopstick Sets, Sushi Chopsticks Bulk, 100 Fully Sealed Disposable Chopsticks Sets by MisoBoom.
features: Our premium quality chopsticks are individually wrapped and fully sealed in plastic wrapping for a safer, cleaner and more sanitary eating experience. MisoBoom brings you 100 sets of premium bamboo wood disposable chopsticks, individually wrapped and sealed for your convenience.

These Japanese style wooden chopsticks are constructed of the finest, top quality, sustainable bamboo wood. Bamboo wood is a material of choice for producing strong and sturdy chopsticks. Our chopsticks are smooth and soft and do not leave any splinters.

This bulk package of 100 sets of disposable chopsticks is the perfect choice for all settings and occasions. For the restaurant or at home, hosting dinner or eating alone, you will have an ample supply of great chopsticks for yourself, your family and all of your friends.

Our superior chopsticks are light weight, strong, sturdy and easy to use. Whether you are well accustomed to eating with chopsticks or a novice chopstick user, you will find these chopsticks easy to grip and comfortable to use. Good chopsticks make a good meal.

Chopsticks are the eating utensils of the far east, used by the Chinese, Japanese and many other Asian countries. Use chopsticks for sushi, sashimi, ramen and other Japanese dishes, dumplings, hotpot, chow mein and other Chinese dishes. You can use chopsticks to eat almost anything!
